reviews.text:
A truly awful experience! I live in Cádiz and was visiting family.

One morning I took my dog ​​to get a bath, and the result was not what I expected after reading the reviews, both in terms of the finish and the price.

I wouldn't go back.

How lucky I was to meet Irene and Lia!

Irene is a true professional, and Niebla looks absolutely gorgeous after her hair and ozone therapy session.

When someone puts love and dedication into something, it definitely shows.

Thank you for everything, we'll definitely be back. See you soon! 💜

Excellent place to bathe my dog. Irene was very patient and gentle with Pachanga. Her fur was super soft and she left very happy. They also sell very cute accessories; we bought her a beach hat ❤️❤️❤️

This morning I took my dog ​​Max for the first time. They bathed him, cut his hair and nails, and cleaned his teeth. We were amazed by the work they did; they were very professional and treated my dog ​​with so much love. They'll definitely be regular customers with us. I highly recommend this dog groomer. They're very professional, a 10 out of 10 for everything, and the shop has some really cool pet products.
I recently took my Pomeranian, Blanquito, and they made him look absolutely gorgeous. I definitely recommend them for their kind treatment of pets and their professionalism.
Today I took our dog Bimba and she looked gorgeous, thank you so much Irene, we will be back.
I love this place, they treat my little one very well. Every time she goes to her trusted place, Maison Lía, she comes out happy. I love what they offer, I highly recommend it.

Besides the fact that the boutique is beautiful and has a huge selection of quality products, their grooming service is fantastic. I took my dog ​​(a young 14kg podenco) there for a bath and deshedding before summer, and I was delighted. The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, inspiring a lot of confidence. When I returned, they were playing ball, patiently waiting for me. I highly recommend it!

A friend recommended it to me and I couldn't be happier. I have a small adopted dog who always got very nervous at the groomer's and came out with uneven fur. Here, it was the complete opposite; Pepa came out absolutely delighted and looking gorgeous.

Fantastic! We took our furry friend for the first time today and we couldn't be happier. He looked absolutely gorgeous and, most importantly, he was calm and stress-free, something we haven't always been able to achieve at other places. You can really see the care, patience, and professionalism with which they work. We will definitely be back. Highly recommended!

Thank you so much for your review! ✨🤍

We hope to see you again soon! 🐶🐾 …
Delighted with the service!! And Siri looked absolutely gorgeous!! Highly recommended, we'll definitely be back.
Irene is not only charming, wonderful, and an excellent professional… but she genuinely loves dogs! I'll be back a thousand times over! 🐶 …

I couldn't be happier that I brought my fur babies here. I have two dogs: a 5 kg Yorkshire Terrier mix and a 20 kg Labrador mix. They both suffer from bone pain due to their age and get very stressed. We had an ozone treatment, a bath, and a haircut for the little one, and an ozone treatment, a bath, and a deshedding treatment for the big one. The service was unbeatable (with a little treat included!), the dogs were happy, clean, and had super shiny coats. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED, AND WE WILL BE BACK.
It's amazing how it washes our little dog 🐕 9 …

The ozone bath definitely works! Jara came out happier, more relaxed, and more beautiful than ever! Irene is a true professional, and that shines through in everything Maison Lia offers. Highly recommended, a real treat for pets, we'll definitely be back!! ❤️

We took him to Sultan because we'd been looking for a place nearby for a while. The experience was fantastic, and the haircut turned out great. We tried the ozone treatment, and his hair looks amazing. We'll definitely be back—100% recommended!

My dog ​​is a rescue and tends to get nervous in unfamiliar places and situations he can't handle. Plus, I'd never taken him to a dog groomer before. To my surprise, from the very first minute, he felt completely at ease with the groomer and was very happy. You can really see how good she is with dogs, and the confidence she inspires is incredible. Chucho left happy and super calm, and absolutely delighted with her.

Besides the impeccable service, they have lots of natural treats and snacks for dogs that, even for dogs who are a bit anxious around food like mine, keep them satisfied for a good while and help them calm down and tire themselves out a little.

We will definitely be back, and I highly recommend this place!

This is the first time I've taken my dog ​​to this groomer. I saw it online and it has great reviews, so I decided to go.
I really liked how she cut her hair. The girl is super friendly and knew exactly how to treat my dog. I'll definitely take her back. They have really nice things for animals and the place is cozy—a 10 out of 10, honestly.
Impeccable service. I took my border collie and she looked gorgeous. The dog was thrilled to be there. The treatment of both the dog and the owner is exceptional. We will definitely be back.
I took my little one for a haircut today, and she came out so happy! The service was excellent, and she looked perfect. This will definitely be my go-to dog groomer from now on ☺️

Excellent experience! It was his first appointment and my dog, who is very afraid, especially of being dried, left happy and calm. Besides the great service, the results were fantastic! We'll be back! 🤎🤍 …

Anyone who has a large dog, especially an adopted one with all its traumas, knows how difficult it is to find a place that not only wants to bathe them but is also well-equipped. Well, I'm so happy to say I've found it!! I took my Mastiff mix to Maison Lia and I couldn't be happier. The patience and care with which Irene treated my dog ​​was priceless. She came out sparkling clean with her nails trimmed, and best of all, she was super happy and comfortable with her. I highly recommend it, and I will definitely be back!!

I highly recommend them!
Super personalized and professional service.
Leaving my dog ​​in a trustworthy place where I know her well-being is their top priority is incredibly important to me.

😍 I loved the place, the attention, the super personalized service, and being attended to directly by the owner, Lia! 🐾

Everything was amazing! We'll be back with Aquiles 🐕‍🦺
Great experience at the groomer's. My dog ​​left super happy. She clearly enjoyed her bath 😍. The place is lovely. Highly recommended. …

I took my dog ​​there yesterday and we were thrilled. I love the place, it's full of thoughtful touches for dogs. The service was wonderful and very friendly. They even texted me halfway through the session to check on my dog ​​:-) We'll definitely be back. Thank you!!!

Maison Lia is a real treat for the neighborhood dogs, and for the neighbors too, wow! It's wonderful. I wish I were a dog, because what a team they have and how carefully they treat them. You can tell they adore them and their work.

Plus, from the moment you walk in, even though the grooming and spa experience isn't for humans, Irene (Lia is her dog, the CEO, haha) makes you feel right at home, like you're with a friend, and you even leave feeling relaxed.

A perfect 10!

Maison Lia recently opened in the neighborhood, but it won me over from the first moment: the way Irene treated my dog, how great he looked, and how beautiful the shop is. By the way, they have some really cool accessories that you can't find in every store. Thanks, Irene, we really needed a business like this in the neighborhood!
We'll be back soon!!

I discovered Maison Lía in the neighborhood and I loved it. From the moment you walk in, you feel a sense of calm, warmth, and good vibes. Irene is a sweetheart: friendly and incredibly fond of dogs.

The result was perfect: my handsome little dog was relaxed and happy! I highly recommend it and we will definitely be back.

Today we took our dog to get a bath and nail trim, and they also gave her an ozone bath. She came out super relaxed! We loved the service and the treatment they provide, we'll definitely be back often!
Spectacular and welcoming place! Very happy with the service! We'll be back!

It's not easy to find new dog grooming salons where we also feel comfortable.
The new dog groomer in the neighborhood is a real find, not only because of the friendly service, but above all, because of Irene's professionalism and good taste. She always knew how to suggest how to wash and treat my dog.
It was such a thoughtful touch that I'll definitely be back.
The place is a real gem, both tasteful and simple.

And it's just steps from the Casa de Campo park. I love it!
Thank you, Irene. It was a pleasure.

Delighted with the service.
I took my poodle in for a haircut and bath, and the result was spectacular.
Irene is lovely and very professional; you can tell she loves what she does.
She's incredibly careful and patient.
My dog ​​was calm and comfortable the whole time.
Besides grooming, you can also buy beautiful, high-quality accessories for our furry friends.
100% recommended; I'll be back.
Definitely.

I'm delighted with the service! The treatment was excellent from the very first moment; she was very professional and caring with my dog. Her experience and passion for her work are evident. My dog ​​left with a great haircut and, above all, calm and happy. In addition, the shop is beautiful and very well-maintained, and they have a selection of dog accessories, all super cute and high-quality. I will definitely return and I recommend it 100%. Thank you so much for the great work, Irene!
Beautiful shop and excellent service

I discovered her by chance and was delighted with how she treated both me and my dog. Despite being new to the neighborhood, she's a true professional. She also has adorable accessories in the shop and natural products for dogs that they absolutely love. I'll definitely be back.

I'm very satisfied with the service I received. Irene is a true professional, and you can tell she puts a lot of love into her work 🥰. She also has some lovely things in her shop for our pets, and natural treats too! …

Excellent service from Irene. She's a true professional, listened to exactly what I wanted for my pet's haircut, and the result was perfect. The grooming salon is new to the neighborhood and has a lovely interior. Punctual, clean, and very friendly. Thank you, Irene!

Absolutely fantastic! The treatment of dogs (and people too) is unparalleled.
Modern and very pleasant place. Great product and great service.
We'll be back!

Incredible! Both the place and the owner... The service is unbeatable. She treats dogs with such love; even my dog, who usually hates baths, was so comfortable with her. 100% recommended. You've just gained a loyal customer. Thank you, Irene!
